critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~1005 lines after adding scan/extract + 3 reports + profile PATCH — recommend modularising routers (auth, catalog, cart, orders, payments, reports, ocr, etc.) on next feature addition; still functional but past the 700-line threshold.

/api/scan/extract correctly strips data: URI prefix, uses session_id scoped to user, parses JSON array defensively (regex + json.loads), and enriches each match with best_distributor — solid implementation.
/api/reports/gst-invoices uses a hard-coded 12% GST rate — consider exposing as config or per-product rate in future, but acceptable for v4 demo.
/api/auth/profile PATCH ignores onboarded flag (correct — onboarding is a separate endpoint) and strips whitespace on all fields.

Frontend testIDs are comprehensive on all new screens (scan-btn, upload-btn, profile-name/phone/shop/gst/address/save, gst-<id>, help-email, help-call, more-analytics/gst/profit/profile/notifications/help) — easy to e2e test.
